content:
“She jumped over the puddle.”
What is the synonym of the word 'jumped'?
explanation: Sinonim dari kata kerja *jumped* (melompat) adalah *hopped* (meloncat).

content: “Please take out the rubbish.” The synonym of 'rubbish' is …
explanation: Kata *rubbish* (sampah) dalam bahasa Inggris bersinonim dengan *trash* atau *garbage*.

content:
“Do not forget to work on your homework, kids.”
In this sentence, 'work on' has the same meaning as …
explanation: Mengerjakan tugas (*work on homework*) bermakna sama dengan *do homework*.

:::passage[Petunjuk Arah (Soal No. 4 – 9)]
*Read the passage below to answer questions 4 to 9!*

“Marla wants to invite her friend Kara over for a sleepover. Marla's mom writes out the following directions for Kara to give to her mother:
**Directions from school to Marla's house:**
1. When coming out of the school parking lot, turn left.
2. Make an immediate right turn onto Chapel Street.
3. At the stop sign, turn right on Oak Street.
4. Go three blocks and turn left on Marble Road.
5. Our house is five houses down on the right, 305 Marble Road.”
:::

Who is being invited to a sleepover?
explanation: Teks menyatakan: *"Marla wants to invite her friend Kara over for a sleepover."* Jadi yang diundang adalah Kara.

content: “Hey, does this belong to you? … book is very awesome.”
explanation: Sebelum kata benda *book*, dibutuhkan *possessive adjective* yaitu *your* (*your book*). *You're* = you are, *yours* = kata ganti mandiri.

content: A motorcycle is commonly faster than a …
explanation: Sepeda motor melaju lebih cepat daripada sepeda kayuh (*bicycle*). Helikopter, pesawat, dan kereta cepat jauh lebih cepat dari sepeda motor.

content: A bus is slower than a …
explanation: Bus umum melaju lebih lambat jika dibandingkan dengan pesawat terbang (*plane*).

content: These are land transportations, EXCEPT ....
explanation: Kapal selam (*submarine*) adalah transportasi bawah air/laut (*water transportation*), bukan transportasi darat.

content: The passengers get on their bus at the .....
explanation: Penumpang menaiki bus di terminal bus (*bus station*).

content: A submarine and a ship are both … transportations.
explanation: Kapal selam dan kapal laut keduanya beroperasi di perairan sehingga merupakan transportasi air (*water transportation*).

content: For her birthday, she wants the … cake in the bakery.
explanation: Bentuk tingkat paling tinggi (*superlative*) untuk kata sifat lebih dari dua suku kata (*expensive*) adalah *the most expensive*.

content: Look at the picture. The t-shirt is … and the iced tea is ….
explanation:
Harga kaos Rp50.000 (mahal/*expensive*) dan es teh Rp2.000 (murah/*cheap*). *Costly* artinya juga mahal, dan *tall/short* tidak berkaitan dengan harga.

Kunci Jawaban: **A**

content: Look at the calendar. Dera was born on that date. How do we say the date in words?
explanation: Kalender menunjukkan tanggal 18 Mei. Tanggal dibaca dengan bilangan bertingkat (*ordinal number*), jadi 18 Mei dibaca *May eighteenth*.

content: Ando bought a car with a lot of money. The car is very …
explanation: Barang yang dibeli dengan uang dalam jumlah banyak bermakna mahal (*expensive*).

content: The following statements are correct, EXCEPT ....
explanation: Mendengarkan musik menggunakan telinga (*ears*), bukan tangan (*hands*).

options.label: A
options.content: Tia tastes the food with her tongue

options.label: B
options.content: Ria eats cake with her mouth

options.label: C
options.content: Mario watches TV with his eyes

options.label: D
options.content: Lala listens to music using her hands

content:
“Derek played well in the match yesterday.”
The word 'yesterday' is an …
explanation: Kata *yesterday* (kemarin) menerangkan waktu terjadinya suatu peristiwa, sehingga merupakan kata keterangan waktu (*adverb of time*).

content:
“I have no idea why she acted like that.”
The word *why* in this sentence functions as a/an …
explanation:
*Why* di sini memulai pertanyaan tidak langsung (*why she acted like that*), sehingga berfungsi sebagai *interrogative adverb*. *Relative adverb* biasanya mengikuti kata benda, misalnya *the reason why*.

Kunci Jawaban: **D**

content:
“Janice came home early today.”
The word 'early' functions as an …
explanation: Kata *early* (lebih awal/pagi) memberikan keterangan waktu kedatangan, sehingga tergolong *adverb of time*.

content:
“She usually fetches her groceries at the nearby farms.”
The word 'usually' is an …
explanation: *Usually* (biasanya) menyatakan seberapa sering suatu perbuatan dilakukan, sehingga merupakan kata keterangan frekuensi (*adverb of frequency*).

content:
“She skipped her routine in the morning yesterday.”
The phrase 'in the morning' is an …
explanation: Frasa *in the morning* menyatakan keterangan waktu pelaksanaan (*adverbial phrase of time*).

:::passage[Teks Cerita Keluarga (Soal No. 26 – 30)]
*Read the text below to answer questions 26 - 30!*

Mr. and Mrs. Smith have one son and one daughter. The son's name is John. The daughter's name is Sarah.
The Smiths live in a house. They have a living room. They watch TV in the living room. The father cooks food in the kitchen. They eat in the dining room. The house has two bedrooms. They sleep in the bedrooms. They keep their clothes in the closet. There is one bathroom. They brush their teeth in the bathroom.
The house has a garden. John and Sarah play in the garden. They have a dog. John and Sarah like to play with the dog there.
:::

How many people live in the house?
explanation:
Mr. Smith, Mrs. Smith, John, dan Sarah: 4 orang.

Kunci Jawaban: **D**

explanation:
*Trimming a bush* artinya memangkas semak. Gambar A menunjukkan orang memangkas semak dengan gunting kebun; B menebang pohon, C menyiram tanaman, D memetik buah.

content:
:::passage[Teks Pengamatan (Soal No. 33 – 36)]
*The following text is for questions number 33 to 36:*

“Hi! My name is Janet Curious. I live on the top of an apartment building in a small town. I’m a very curious woman and I always want to learn what other people are doing. As you see, now I’m watching people in my neighbourhood through my binoculars.
Let me have a look at the park on Pole Street. Oh, it’s so crowded with children as usual. Kathryn is skipping rope and Grace is playing with her doll. Walter and Harold are feeding a few street dogs as they love animals so much. Pamela is playing on the monkey bars while her brother is swinging.
Terry, Laura and Sharon are sliding and laughing. Shirley is playing volleyball with a group of children, but she isn’t good at it. Mr. and Mrs. Brown are resting on a bench and getting some fresh air. Some teens are sitting under the big pine tree. Dennis is running and trying to fly his kite while his friend, James, is jumping up and down with joy. It’s so nice to watch people here on my balcony, but I must go now.”
:::

“… now I’m watching people in my neighbourhood through my **binoculars**.” Which picture shows the bold word?
explanation:
*Binoculars* adalah teropong berlensa dua (gambar C). A kacamata, B teleskop, D mikroskop.

Kunci Jawaban: **C**

content:
:::passage[Teks Cerita: Apples from Malang (Soal No. 37 – 40)]
*The following text is for questions number 37 to 40:*

“Dad is just coming home from Malang to Surabaya. He brought us 5 kilograms of apples. When I counted them, there were 42 apples in total. Mum made three packs of apples, each consisting of 8 apples: one for the lady next door, one for Uncle Carl, and one for Grandma. I saw my brother had already eaten three apples, while I haven’t even taken one. Mum saved a dozen and kept them in the refrigerator. She said she would make an apple pie tomorrow. She asked me to serve the rest on a plate.”
:::

Where did Dad buy the apples?
explanation:
Teks: *“Dad is just coming home from Malang to Surabaya.”* Apel dibawa dari Malang.

Kunci Jawaban: **A**
